title.narrative: Empowered and Connected: Supporting Jordan Civil Society to Collaborate and Defend its Space

description.narrative:
The proposed action will have significant impacts on the Jordan society, its government and its institutions. In line with the EU Country Roadmap for Engagement with Civil Society (2018-2020), this project aligns with all four priorities:

1. By enhancing CSOs¿ capacity to achieve good governance practices and work collaboratively in partnerships, the ability of CSOs to be constructively engaging in the implementation of EU partnership priorities and EUMS bilateral agreements with the GoJ.

2. By providing CSOs with legal empowerment and legal support, as well as the capacity to produce knowledge and disseminate it, enhanced capacity to collaborate within joint actions for advocacy, and creating participatory open dialogue with government officials to enhance understanding, a more enabling environment for CSOs can be achieved.

3. Through enhancing CSOs¿ ability to work in coalitions, their ability to be included in formulating public policies and supporting the achievement of Jordan¿s development priorities will be enhanced.

4. Through creating resources for good governance knowledge and self-regulation and hosting training sessions and workshops, the internal governance practices of CSOs will be improved.

Target groups and final beneficiaries:

The target groups and final beneficiaries will be 3 coalitions, 150 CSOs, 60 civil rights activists, 50 government officials, 20 auditors, and 40 lawyers.
